newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Kwong Hing shares rise on debut.
newsitem.headline: HK's Kwong Hing shares rise on debut.

text.p: Shares of knitted fabrics manufacturer Kwong Hing International Holdings Ltd were trading at HK$1.38 per share after the first 20 minutes on its first day of trading, compared with its issue price of HK$1.20.
The company's shares debuted at HK$1.50 before profit-taking interest emerged, brokers said.
Kwong Hing offered 45 million shares at HK$1.20 each in its initial public offering and had been 8.35 times oversubscribed.

The company said net proceeds of HK$33 million from the new issue would be used to buy knitting, bleaching, dyeing and setting machineries, to upgrade its office information system and for working capital.
